offering_description.value: Transports finished vehicles for automakers, dealerships and other automotive businesses. It moves vehicles from factories, ports, rail terminals and other pickup points using its own fleet and contracted carriers.

primary_services.value: finished vehicle hauling; vehicle freight brokerage

customer_segment.value: B2B: automakers, automotive dealerships, vehicle auctions and rental fleets

end_markets.value: automotive manufacturing; automotive retail; used vehicle remarketing; vehicle rental

revenue_model.value: service fees: vehicle shipments hauled by its fleet or arranged through third-party carriers

value_chain_position.value: asset operator: uses its own car-hauling fleet to move finished vehicles for automakers and other automotive businesses; service provider: matches vehicle shipment requests from automotive businesses with independent motor carriers

geography_served.value: US national: nationwide vehicle transportation across the United States

specialization.value: related lines: fleet-based vehicle hauling and vehicle freight brokerage

distribution_channels.value: direct sales: direct relationships with automakers, dealer groups and other automotive shippers

regulatory_exposure.value: medium: interstate vehicle hauling and freight brokerage subject to FMCSA operating authority and motor carrier safety rules

notes: The extent of cross-border operations is uncertain.
